title: אוסף דמויות פנטזיה
summary: אוסף מהיר של חמש טרנספורמציות: קוסמת קרח, אנוביס, לוחם צללים, יצור קרח מכונף ודרקון קרח.

phases.what: Seated woman gets glowing blue left eye and icy half-face, stands up in silver-blue kimono with fur collar and glowing hand.
Close-up of eyes getting jagged black makeup and gold glow, transforming into seated black-and-gold Anubis warrior.
Seated streamer gets metallic bird mask with purple eyes, stands in dark hooded armor with purple runes.
Eye close-up with blue lightning, standing woman gets ice hands and turns into winged crystalline ice creature.
Standing woman conjures blue energy swirls, eyes glow blue, crouches into mist and transforms into roaring winged ice dragon.

remix.prompt: The person in the image is live-streaming at home and undergoes a rapid 5-part fantasy transformation montage while keeping the person recognizable until masks or full creature forms cover the face. First, their left eye glows blue with frost, standing in a silver kimono with fur collar and icy hand mist. Second, black jagged makeup and gold eyes appear, morphing them into a black-and-gold jackal-headed Anubis warrior in a golden temple. Third, a silver bird mask with glowing purple eyes and dark hooded purple-rune armor materialize on them as they stand. Fourth, blue lightning sparks from their eye, ice covers their hands, and they become a crystalline winged ice creature with a glowing chest core in a neon studio. Finally, they spin blue energy ribbons, crouch into icy mist, and transform into a massive roaring winged ice dragon with a glowing blue maw. Cinematic fantasy lighting, vertical framing.
